title: Egyptian Keto Chickpea Wrap
description: A keto twist on the classic Middle Eastern wrap, made with chickpeas and wrapped in a low-carb wrap.

ingredients.name: wrap
ingredients.notes: made from almond flour or coconut flour

instructions: Preheat a non-stick skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the quaint (Egyptian spice blend) to the skillet and let it toast for 1 minute.
Add the chickpeas to the skillet and cook for 3-4 minutes, or until they are lightly browned.
Add the malty and egyptian spices to the skillet and stir to combine.
Warm the low-carb wrap in the microwave for 10-15 seconds.
Assemble the wrap by spooning the chickpea mixture onto the center of the wrap.
Add salt and pepper to taste.
Fold the bottom half of the wrap up over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll the wrap up tightly.
